featured_individuals.crime_convicted_of_raw: Rape and Murder (of Deborah Sykes in 1984)
featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Darryl Hunt was wrongfully convicted of the rape and murder of Deborah Sykes in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. He was convicted in 1985 and exonerated in 2004 after serving 19 years in prison. DNA evidence identified the actual perpetrator, Willard E. Brown.
contributing_factors_raw: Racial bias (convicted by all-white jury in second trial)
organizations_involved_raw: Darryl Hunt Project for Freedom and Justice (founded by him)
